title: ✨ गोलू हाथी का पहला हिंदी वाक्य... बच्चे यहीं अटक जाते हैं #hindikids #bolna
title_alts: ✨ गोलू हाथी का तीन शब्द वाला वाक्य... रोज़ के काम खुद बताता है #hindikids #bolna
✨ गोलू हाथी बोलता है मैं तैयार हूँ... अटकना यहीं खत्म हो जाता है #hindikids #bolna
refrain: मैं तैयार हूँ, चलो शुरू करें।
description_hook: तीन शब्दों का एक वाक्य, जो बच्चा पूरे दिन काम में लाएगा। साथ बोलिए, फिर दोहराइए।

characters.name: गोलू
characters.description: toy guide, grey plush elephant, red knitted scarf, one floppy left ear

scenes.narration: आज हम एक छोटा वाक्य सीखेंगे। मैं तैयार हूँ।
scenes.caption: Today we learn one short sentence: I am ready.
scenes.image_brief: A grey plush elephant toy with a red knitted scarf and one floppy left ear, sitting upright on a low wooden stool in a tidy living room, soft morning light through a window, plain wooden floor.

scenes.narration: वाक्य दोहराओ। मैं तैयार हूँ। मैं तैयार हूँ। तीन शब्द, एक पूरा वाक्य।
scenes.caption: Repeat it: I am ready. I am ready. Three words, one whole sentence.
scenes.image_brief: Three chunky wooden blocks in a neat row on a soft rug, each block a different colour, the grey plush elephant toy with a red knitted scarf and one floppy left ear sitting behind the row, gentle daylight from a nearby window.

scenes.narration: देखो, दरवाज़े पर जूते रखे हैं। अब बोलो, मैं तैयार हूँ।
scenes.caption: Look, shoes waiting by the door. Now say it: I am ready.
scenes.image_brief: A small pair of blue canvas shoes placed neatly side by side on a doormat in front of a closed wooden front door, bright daylight falling across the mat, empty home hallway.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो। मैं तैयार हूँ। ज़ोर से, एक बार और।
scenes.caption: Say it with me: I am ready. Louder now, one more time.
scenes.image_brief: The grey plush elephant toy with a red knitted scarf and one floppy left ear sitting on a rug facing a small round floor mirror, sunlight warming the rug, cosy living room corner.

scenes.narration: शाबाश। मैं तैयार हूँ, चलो शुरू करें।
scenes.caption: Well done. I am ready, let us begin.
scenes.image_brief: A small zipped backpack standing on a wooden floor with a steel water bottle beside it, the grey plush elephant toy with a red knitted scarf and one floppy left ear sitting next to the bottle, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: अब खाने की बात। थाली खाली है, बोलो, मैं भूखा हूँ। पानी चाहिए? बोलो, मैं प्यासा हूँ।
scenes.caption: Now food. Plate is empty: I am hungry. Want water? Say: I am thirsty.
scenes.image_brief: An empty steel plate and an empty steel tumbler on a low kitchen table with a covered water jug behind them, soft afternoon light from a kitchen window, clean tabletop.

scenes.narration: कौन सा सही है? मैं खुश हूँ, या खुश मैं हूँ? सही है, मैं खुश हूँ।
scenes.caption: Which one is right? I am happy, or happy I am? Right: I am happy.
scenes.image_brief: Two round floor cushions standing on their edges side by side on a rug in a bright playroom, one cushion yellow and one green, sunlight spread across the floor.

scenes.narration: हमने बोला मैं तैयार हूँ, मैं भूखा हूँ, मैं खुश हूँ। मैं तैयार हूँ, चलो शुरू करें।
scenes.caption: We said: I am ready, I am hungry, I am happy. I am ready, let us begin.
scenes.image_brief: The blue canvas shoes, the empty steel plate and the yellow round cushion lined up in a row on a wooden floor, the grey plush elephant toy with a red knitted scarf and one floppy left ear sitting at the end of the row, warm late light.

title: 💛 चीकू बत्तख का जादुई शब्द कृपया... बिना इसके बात रूखी लगती है #hindikids #kripya
title_alts: 💛 चीकू बत्तख का छोटा निवेदन कृपया... चार शब्द काम करा देते हैं #hindikids #kripya
💛 चीकू बत्तख कृपया कहना सीखता है... बिना इसके बात अधूरी रह जाती है #hindikids #kripya
refrain: कृपया कहो, और दरवाज़े खुल जाते हैं।
description_hook: एक शब्द जोड़ते ही मांग निवेदन बन जाती है। बच्चे के साथ यही चार शब्द बोलिए।

characters.name: चीकू
characters.description: toy guide, yellow plush duck, small blue cloth cap, orange stitched beak

scenes.narration: आज एक जादू वाला शब्द सीखेंगे। कृपया मुझे पानी दीजिए।
scenes.caption: Today we learn one magic word: please give me water.
scenes.image_brief: A yellow plush duck toy with a small blue cloth cap and an orange stitched beak sitting on a kitchen counter beside an empty glass tumbler, bright daylight from a window above the sink, clean tidy kitchen.

scenes.narration: कृपया मुझे पानी दीजिए। कृपया मुझे पानी दीजिए। कृपया सबसे पहले आता है।
scenes.caption: Please give me water. Please give me water. Please always comes first.
scenes.image_brief: A clear glass tumbler full of water standing alone in the middle of a wooden table, sunlight passing through the water and casting a bright patch on the wood, quiet kitchen.

scenes.narration: गिलास ऊँची अलमारी में है। बोलो, कृपया मुझे पानी दीजिए।
scenes.caption: The glass sits on a high shelf. Say: please give me water.
scenes.image_brief: A row of glass tumblers on a high wooden kitchen shelf far above a low countertop, a small stool standing on the floor below, warm kitchen light from a side window.

scenes.narration: अब तुम बोलो। कृपया मुझे पानी दीजिए। धीरे और साफ़।
scenes.caption: Now you say it: please give me water. Slowly and clearly.
scenes.image_brief: The yellow plush duck toy with a small blue cloth cap and an orange stitched beak sitting on a low stool in front of an open kitchen doorway, soft daylight coming through the doorway, empty tidy floor.

scenes.narration: बहुत अच्छा। कृपया कहो, और दरवाज़े खुल जाते हैं।
scenes.caption: Very good. Say please, and doors open for you.
scenes.image_brief: A full glass of water standing on a low kitchen countertop within easy reach, one gap left in the row of tumblers on the high shelf above it, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: खिलौनों की अलमारी बंद है। बोलो, कृपया अलमारी खोल दीजिए।
scenes.caption: The toy cupboard is shut. Say: please open the cupboard.
scenes.image_brief: A closed wooden toy cupboard in a small bedroom with a wooden train and a red ball on the floor in front of it, gentle afternoon light from a window, tidy room.

scenes.narration: बस में जगह चाहिए? बोलो, कृपया थोड़ा खिसकिए। कृपया हर जगह चलता है।
scenes.caption: Need room on the bus? Say: please move over a little. Please works anywhere.
scenes.image_brief: Two empty seats inside a city bus with a cloth bag taking up half of the window seat, daylight through the bus window, quiet empty bus interior.

scenes.narration: कौन सा वाक्य मीठा है? पानी दो, या कृपया मुझे पानी दीजिए? दूसरा सही है।
scenes.caption: Which sentence is kinder? Give water, or please give me water? The second.
scenes.image_brief: Two paper cups standing side by side on a windowsill, one plain white and one painted with a small flower, bright daylight, plain wall behind them.

scenes.narration: हमने कहा कृपया पानी, कृपया अलमारी, कृपया थोड़ा खिसकिए। कृपया कहो, और दरवाज़े खुल जाते हैं।
scenes.caption: We said please for water, the cupboard, the seat. Say please, doors open.
scenes.image_brief: The yellow plush duck toy with a small blue cloth cap and an orange stitched beak sitting on a wooden floor beside a full glass of water and an open toy cupboard, warm late afternoon light from a window.

title: 🌟 नन्हा भालू का सवाल, यह क्या है... बिन पूछे नाम कैसे पता चले #hindikids #sawal
title_alts: 🌟 नन्हा भालू का तीन शब्दों वाला सवाल... नए नाम खोल देता है #hindikids #sawal
🌟 नन्हा भालू यह क्या है पूछता है... चुप बैठना यहीं छूट जाता है #hindikids #sawal
refrain: पूछो यह क्या है, और नाम मिल जाता है।
description_hook: तीन शब्दों का एक सवाल, और आसपास की हर चीज़ का नाम खुलने लगता है। बच्चे के साथ दोहराइए।

characters.name: नन्हा
characters.description: toy guide, small brown plush bear, green dungarees, round patch on one knee

scenes.narration: आज एक सवाल पूछना सीखेंगे। वाक्य, यह क्या है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn how to ask one question: what is this.
scenes.image_brief: A small brown plush bear in green dungarees with a round patch on one knee, sitting on a wide windowsill in a bright empty room, clear morning light coming through the glass.

scenes.narration: यह क्या है? यह क्या है? तीन शब्द, पूरा सवाल।
scenes.caption: What is this? What is this? Three words, one whole question.
scenes.image_brief: Three smooth round river stones in a neat row on a low wooden table, the small brown plush bear in green dungarees with a round patch on one knee sitting behind them, soft daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: मेज़ पर चम्मच है। पूछो, यह क्या है? यह चम्मच है।
scenes.caption: A spoon is on the table. Ask: what is this? This is a spoon.
scenes.image_brief: A single steel spoon lying alone in the middle of a bare wooden dining table, clear daylight from a nearby window making the metal shine, quiet kitchen.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ पूछो। यह क्या है? ज़ोर से।
scenes.caption: Ask along with me: what is this? Louder now.
scenes.image_brief: A cardboard box with its lid slightly lifted on a rug, nothing visible inside, the small brown plush bear in green dungarees with a round patch on one knee sitting beside it, warm indoor light.

scenes.narration: बहुत खूब। पूछो यह क्या है, और नाम मिल जाता है।
scenes.caption: Wonderful. Ask what is this, and the name comes to you.
scenes.image_brief: A steel spoon resting inside a small steel bowl on a wooden table, the small brown plush bear in green dungarees with a round patch on one knee sitting next to the bowl, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: बगीचे में पीला फूल दिखा। पूछो, यह क्या है? यह गेंदा है।
scenes.caption: A yellow flower in the garden. Ask: what is this? It is a marigold.
scenes.image_brief: One bright yellow marigold flower blooming in a clay pot on a garden step, green leaves around it, early morning sunlight and dew on the soil.

scenes.narration: ऊपर कुछ उड़ रहा है। पूछो, यह क्या है? यह पतंग है।
scenes.caption: Something is flying above. Ask: what is this? It is a kite.
scenes.image_brief: A red and white paper kite high in a clear blue sky above low rooftops, its string trailing down out of frame, bright afternoon sunlight.

scenes.narration: कौन सा सही है? यह क्या है, या क्या यह है? पहला सही है।
scenes.caption: Which is right? What is this, or this is what? The first one is right.
scenes.image_brief: Two upturned white teacups side by side on a metal tray on a kitchen counter, one plain and one with a blue rim, bright daylight, plain wall behind.

scenes.narration: जूता दिखे तो क्या पूछोगे? यह क्या है।
scenes.caption: If you see a shoe, what will you ask? What is this.
scenes.image_brief: One small brown leather shoe sitting alone on a coir doormat by a doorway, afternoon light falling across the mat, plain tiled floor.

scenes.narration: हमने पूछा चम्मच, फूल, पतंग पर। पूछो यह क्या है, और नाम मिल जाता है।
scenes.caption: We asked about a spoon, a flower, a kite. Ask, and the name comes.
scenes.image_brief: A steel spoon, a yellow marigold flower and a small paper kite laid side by side on a wooden floor, the small brown plush bear in green dungarees with a round patch on one knee sitting behind them, warm evening light.

title: 🎈 टिंकू बंदर का जोड़ने वाला शब्द और... एक वाक्य छोटा क्यों पड़ता है #hindikids #vaakya
title_alts: 🎈 टिंकू बंदर और लगाकर दो चीज़ें मांगता है... एक ही वाक्य में #hindikids #vaakya
🎈 टिंकू बंदर का छोटा शब्द और... आधी बात कहने की आदत रोकता है #hindikids #vaakya
refrain: और लगाओ, दो बातें एक वाक्य बन जाती हैं।
description_hook: बच्चा एक चीज़ मांगता है और दूसरी भूल जाता है। एक छोटा शब्द दोनों को एक वाक्य में ले आता है।
problem_domain: joining two ideas in one sentence

characters.name: टिंकू
characters.description: toy guide, cloth monkey, orange striped shirt, long curled tail

scenes.narration: आज सीखेंगे दो चीज़ें एक वाक्य में। शब्द है और।
scenes.caption: Today we learn to put two things in one sentence. The word is and.
scenes.image_brief: A cloth monkey toy in an orange striped shirt with a long curled tail sitting on a wooden dining chair beside an empty steel plate and an empty glass, soft morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: और, और। यह छोटा शब्द दो चीज़ों को जोड़ देता है।
scenes.caption: And, and. This small word joins two things together.
scenes.image_brief: Two wooden blocks on a table with a short red ribbon tied between them holding them together, plain tabletop, soft daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: थाली में रोटी, गिलास में दूध। बोलो, मुझे रोटी और दूध चाहिए।
scenes.caption: Roti on the plate, milk in the glass. Say: I want roti and milk.
scenes.image_brief: One round roti on a steel plate beside a full glass of milk on a low wooden table, morning light from a kitchen window, clean tabletop.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो। मुझे रोटी और दूध चाहिए। ज़ोर से।
scenes.caption: Say it with me: I want roti and milk. Louder now.
scenes.image_brief: The cloth monkey toy in an orange striped shirt with a long curled tail sitting on a low stool facing the plate of roti and the glass of milk on the table, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: वाह। और लगाओ, दो बातें एक वाक्य बन जाती हैं।
scenes.caption: Lovely. Add and, and two things become one sentence.
scenes.image_brief: A steel tray holding the plate of roti and the glass of milk together, both within easy reach at the edge of a wooden table, bright daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: अब खिलौने। बोलो, मुझे गेंद और गुड़िया चाहिए। टोपी और चप्पल भी।
scenes.caption: Now toys. Say: I want the ball and the doll. Hat and sandals too.
scenes.image_brief: A red rubber ball and a cloth doll side by side on a playroom floor, with a yellow sun hat and a pair of small sandals placed further back near the doorway, bright afternoon light.

scenes.narration: कौन सा पूरा वाक्य है? रोटी दूध, या मुझे रोटी और दूध चाहिए? दूसरा वाला।
scenes.caption: Which is a whole sentence? Roti milk, or I want roti and milk? The second.
scenes.image_brief: Two serving trays side by side on a kitchen table, one tray holding a roti and a glass of milk together, the other tray holding only a roti, bright daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: हमने जोड़ा रोटी और दूध, गेंद और गुड़िया। और लगाओ, दो बातें एक वाक्य बन जाती हैं।
scenes.caption: We joined roti and milk, ball and doll. Add and, two things, one sentence.
scenes.image_brief: A roti on a steel plate, a glass of milk, a red rubber ball and a cloth doll arranged in a row on a wooden floor, the cloth monkey toy in an orange striped shirt with a long curled tail sitting at the end of the row, warm late afternoon light.

title: 🌈 मोती बिल्ली बताती है अभी क्या हो रहा है... यहीं बच्चे उलझते हैं #hindikids #sikhen
title_alts: 🌈 मोती बिल्ली का रहा है वाला वाक्य... अभी का काम साफ़ बताता है #hindikids #sikhen
🌈 मोती बिल्ली अभी और पहले का फ़र्क बताती है... गलत वाक्य रुक जाता है #hindikids #sikhen
refrain: जो अभी हो रहा है, वही बोलो।
description_hook: बच्चा बीती बात और अभी की बात मिला देता है। एक छोटा वाक्य दोनों को अलग कर देता है।

characters.name: मोती
characters.description: toy guide, knitted white cat, grey ears, blue collar with a small bell

scenes.narration: आज बताएंगे कि अभी क्या हो रहा है। रहा है।
scenes.caption: Today we tell what is happening right now. Is happening.
scenes.image_brief: A knitted white cat toy with grey ears and a blue collar with a small bell, sitting on a wooden floor in a sunlit empty room while a striped ball rolls past it, warm daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: रहा है, रही है। यह बताता है कि काम अभी चल रहा है।
scenes.caption: Is happening, is going on. It tells you the action is on right now.
scenes.image_brief: A wooden spinning top still turning on a smooth tiled floor beside the knitted white cat toy with grey ears and a blue collar with a small bell, bright indoor light.

scenes.narration: पंखा घूम रहा है। बोलो, पंखा घूम रहा है।
scenes.caption: The fan is turning. Say it: the fan is turning.
scenes.image_brief: A white three blade ceiling fan turning below a plain white ceiling, its blades caught mid turn, a bright window below it with a light curtain lifting in the breeze.

scenes.narration: बाहर बारिश हो रही है। बोलो, बारिश हो रही है।
scenes.caption: It is raining outside. Say it: it is raining.
scenes.image_brief: Rain falling against a window pane with water running down the glass, a wet green courtyard visible outside, soft grey daylight.

scenes.narration: अब तुम बोलो। कुछ चल रहा है, तो बोलो रहा है।
scenes.caption: Now your turn. If something is going on, say is going on.
scenes.image_brief: The knitted white cat toy with grey ears and a blue collar with a small bell sitting on a windowsill next to rain streaked glass, soft grey daylight, quiet room.

scenes.narration: शाबाश। जो अभी हो रहा है, वही बोलो।
scenes.caption: Well done. Say what is happening right now.
scenes.image_brief: A wooden toy train rolling along a curved wooden track on a rug, the knitted white cat toy with grey ears and a blue collar with a small bell sitting beside the track, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: चिड़िया दाना खा रही है। बोलो, चिड़िया खा रही है।
scenes.caption: The sparrow is eating grain. Say it: the sparrow is eating.
scenes.image_brief: A small brown sparrow on a stone ledge pecking at scattered grain, green leaves behind it, bright morning sunlight on the stone.

scenes.narration: झूला हिल रहा है? बोलो, झूला हिल रहा है।
scenes.caption: Is the swing moving? Say it: the swing is moving.
scenes.image_brief: An empty wooden swing hanging from a tree branch in a garden, caught mid swing with its ropes taut, afternoon sunlight coming through the leaves.

scenes.narration: कौन सा अभी का है? पंखा घूमता था, या पंखा घूम रहा है? दूसरा।
scenes.caption: Which one is about now? The fan was turning, or the fan is turning?
scenes.image_brief: Two ceiling fans side by side on the long white ceiling of a hall, one with its blades caught mid turn and the other completely still, daylight from tall windows.

scenes.narration: पंखा, बारिश, चिड़िया और झूला, सब चल रहा है। जो अभी हो रहा है, वही बोलो।
scenes.caption: Fan, rain, sparrow, swing, all going on. Say what is happening now.
scenes.image_brief: The knitted white cat toy with grey ears and a blue collar with a small bell sitting on a windowsill with rain on the glass behind it, a sparrow on the wet ledge outside and a garden swing moving beyond, a ceiling fan turning above the room, soft grey light.

title: 😊 बिट्टू मेंढक रंग वाला वाक्य बोलता है... आधा वाक्य यहीं छूटता है #hindikids #rang
title_alts: 😊 बिट्टू मेंढक का वाक्य, पहले नाम फिर रंग... चीज़ पूरी बताता है #hindikids #rang
😊 बिट्टू मेंढक लाल सेब पर वाक्य बनाता है... रंग भूलना यहीं रुकता है #hindikids #rang
refrain: पहले नाम, फिर रंग, वाक्य पूरा।
description_hook: रंग का नाम आ जाता है, पर वाक्य अधूरा रह जाता है। नाम पहले, रंग बाद में, और बात पूरी।

characters.name: बिट्टू
characters.description: toy guide, green felt frog, yellow spots on its back, wide stitched smile

scenes.narration: आज चीज़ का रंग बताना सीखेंगे। यह सेब लाल है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn to tell the colour of a thing. This apple is red.
scenes.image_brief: A green felt frog toy with yellow spots on its back and a wide stitched smile, sitting on a wooden table beside one shiny red apple, bright daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: यह सेब लाल है। यह सेब लाल है। नाम, फिर रंग।
scenes.caption: This apple is red. This apple is red. Name first, then colour.
scenes.image_brief: One shiny red apple standing alone in the centre of a white plate on a wooden table, clear even daylight, plain pale wall behind.

scenes.narration: टोकरी में एक सेब रखा है। बोलो, यह सेब लाल है।
scenes.caption: One apple sits in the basket. Say it: this apple is red.
scenes.image_brief: A woven cane basket on a kitchen counter holding one shiny red apple, bright morning light from a window, tiled wall behind the counter.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो। यह सेब लाल है। अब धीरे से।
scenes.caption: Say it with me: this apple is red. Now say it slowly.
scenes.image_brief: The green felt frog toy with yellow spots on its back and a wide stitched smile sitting on a low stool facing the cane basket with the red apple, warm daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: बहुत अच्छा। पहले नाम, फिर रंग, वाक्य पूरा।
scenes.caption: Very good. Name first, then colour, and the sentence is whole.
scenes.image_brief: A shiny red apple resting on a white plate beside the green felt frog toy with yellow spots on its back and a wide stitched smile on a wooden table, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: अब कपड़े। बोलो, यह मोजा नीला है। यह तौलिया सफ़ेद है।
scenes.caption: Now clothes. Say: this sock is blue. This towel is white.
scenes.image_brief: A blue sock and a folded white towel laid side by side on a wooden bed frame in a bright bedroom, clean morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: आसमान देखो। बोलो, यह बादल काला है? नहीं, यह बादल सफ़ेद है।
scenes.caption: Look at the sky. Is this cloud black? No, this cloud is white.
scenes.image_brief: One fluffy white cloud in a wide blue sky above a flat rooftop with a water tank, bright afternoon sunlight.

scenes.narration: कौन सा पूरा है? सेब लाल, या यह सेब लाल है? दूसरा पूरा वाक्य है।
scenes.caption: Which is whole? Apple red, or this apple is red? The second one.
scenes.image_brief: Two shiny red apples on a windowsill side by side, one lit brightly by the sun and one in soft shade, plain wall behind them.

scenes.narration: हमने कहा सेब लाल, मोजा नीला, बादल सफ़ेद। पहले नाम, फिर रंग, वाक्य पूरा।
scenes.caption: We said apple red, sock blue, cloud white. Name, then colour, done.
scenes.image_brief: A shiny red apple, a blue sock and a folded white towel arranged in a row on a wooden floor, the green felt frog toy with yellow spots on its back and a wide stitched smile sitting at the end of the row, warm late afternoon light.

title: 🔵 रंग “नीला” पहचानें... रंग भ्रम से बचें #colors #kids
title_alts: 🔵 नीला रंग सीखें... बच्चों को रंग पहचान में मदद #learning
🔵 नीला समझें... चित्र में गलती न हो #education
description_hook: नीले रंग को पहचानें और सही शब्द बोलें। बच्चों को रंगों में स्पष्टता दें।

scenes.narration: आज हम नीला रंग सीखेंगे।
scenes.caption: Today we will learn the color blue.
scenes.image_brief: A sky blue background with the word नीला written in white.

scenes.narration: नीला, आवाज़ में नीला, रूप में नीला, नीला, आवाज़ में नीला, रूप में नीला।
scenes.caption: Blue, sound 'neela', shape 'blue', repeated twice.
scenes.image_brief: Close-up of the word नीला in bold Hindi font beside a blue swatch.

scenes.narration: नीला समुद्र दिखता है।
scenes.caption: The blue sea is shown.
scenes.image_brief: A calm blue ocean under a bright sun, horizon visible.

scenes.narration: अब साथ में बोलो, नीला!
scenes.caption: Now say together, Neela!
scenes.image_brief: Text bubble with नीला over the sea, gentle sunlight.

scenes.narration: नीला, सही रंग!
scenes.caption: Blue, correct color!
scenes.image_brief: The word नीला highlighted in blue over the ocean.

scenes.narration: नीला बल्ब, नीला बल्ब।
scenes.caption: Blue light bulb.
scenes.image_brief: A glowing blue light bulb hanging in a dark room.

scenes.narration: नीला जामुनी फूल, नीला जामुनी फूल।
scenes.caption: Blue violet flower.
scenes.image_brief: A close-up of a blue violet blooming in a garden.

scenes.narration: क्या यह समुद्र है या बल्ब? उत्तर समुद्र।
scenes.caption: Is this sea or bulb? Answer: sea.
scenes.image_brief: Split screen with sea left, light bulb right.

scenes.narration: हमने नीला, समुद्र, बल्ब, फूल सीखा, नीला नीला, सही रंग!
scenes.caption: We learned blue, sea, bulb, flower, neela neela, correct color!
scenes.image_brief: Collage of all previous scenes arranged brightly, warm lighting.

title: 🔤 अक्षर “म” सीखें... शब्दों में गलती से बचें #learn #hindi
title_alts: 🔤 अक्षर म का सही उच्चारण... बच्चों की शब्दावली मजबूत बनाएं #kids
🔤 म अक्षर सीखें... वाक्य में त्रुटि न हो #education
description_hook: आज हम अक्षर “म” को पहचानेंगे और सही बोलेंगे। बच्चों को शब्दों में त्रुटि से बचने का आसान तरीका सीखें।

scenes.narration: आज हम अक्षर म सीखेंगे।
scenes.caption: Today we will learn the letter M.
scenes.image_brief: Bright classroom wall with the letter M drawn in large colorful letters, natural daylight.

scenes.narration: म, आवाज़ में म, आकार में म, म, आवाज़ में म, आकार में म।
scenes.caption: M, sound 'm', shape 'M', repeated twice.
scenes.image_brief: Close-up of the letter M in a bold font on a white board, soft side lighting.

scenes.narration: माँ का शब्द है माँ।
scenes.caption: The word 'Maa' uses the letter M.
scenes.image_brief: A picture of a mother holding a child in a sunny park.

scenes.narration: अब साथ में कहो, माँ!
scenes.caption: Now say together, Maa!
scenes.image_brief: Text bubble with माँ appearing over the mother picture, gentle afternoon light.

scenes.narration: माँ, सही शब्द!
scenes.caption: Maa, correct word!
scenes.image_brief: The word माँ highlighted in green on a tablet screen.

scenes.narration: मटका, मटका, मटका।
scenes.caption: Mug, mug, mug.
scenes.image_brief: A colorful clay mug on a kitchen table near a window.

scenes.narration: मेला, मेला, मेला।
scenes.caption: Fair, fair, fair.
scenes.image_brief: A bustling fair with balloons and stalls under bright sky.

scenes.narration: क्या यह माँ है या मेला? सही उत्तर माँ।
scenes.caption: Is this Maa or Mela? Correct answer: Maa.
scenes.image_brief: Two pictures side by side: a mother and a fair, split-screen.

scenes.narration: हमने म, माँ, मटका, मेला सीखा, म म म, सही शब्द!
scenes.caption: We learned M, Maa, Mug, Fair, M M M, correct word!
scenes.image_brief: Collage of all previous images arranged in a grid, warm lighting.
